body:
TrustLadder stopped work on this. The package is past its soft budget with no demonstrated path to completion. The latest repair still reports O2/O3 unmet and the same six native-census failures identified in review. Its search found authorization for a different delivery that explicitly excludes the required image-X BF16 scope; execution remains blocked on qualification and custody decisions from designated external owners. Updating the existing handoff preserves useful evidence but does not resolve that prerequisite. This decision does not count platform losses against the package.
